start.description: Start timestamp for the value.  If null, assumed to be beginning-of-time (BOT).

end.description: End timestamp for the value.  If null, assumed to be end-of-time (EOT).

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

createdAt.description:
The timestamp in UTC zone of when the object instance was created via {#createWithOverlapsResolved}.
Since {@link RiskMlModelPredictionHistory} objects created through {#createWithOverlapsResolved} can potentially lead to
existing objects to be re-upserted without identity after resolution,
this field is being used to retain the original timestamp at which it was created.
This field should be preferred over meta.createdAt for the timestamp at which the object was created.

isPredicting.description: Status of the current predictions made.

predictionFailureReason.description:
Reason for empty predictions.
If predictions are correctly made, then the value would be N/A
enum: Error while running ML Flow Job
